own_solution.law: lambda = c/f; successive closed-pipe resonances differ in column length by lambda/2; t = (lambda/2)/vw

T0685.regime: radius below about 0.29 lambda (plane-wave regime, below the first transverse-mode cutoff ka = 1.84); end correction is stated fixed

T0899.regime: radius below about 0.29 lambda (plane-wave regime, below the first transverse-mode cutoff ka = 1.84); end correction is stated fixed

defect_reasons.other: The C cancellation relations for TBEDA/TFF60 state that the air column length is q - vw t and resonates at 5 lam/4 then 3 lam/4, i.e. that the column shortens as the water falls; in fact the column between the open top and a falling water surface lengthens (L = q + vw t), and from 130 cm the next resonances are at 9 lam/4 and 11 lam/4 (less end correction), so the shown relation is physically false even though the cancelled answer is right.

counterexamples: With q = 130 cm and lam = 66.99 cm, the authors' relation t = (q - 5 lam/4)/vw places a resonance at column length 83.7 cm, which the column never reaches since it only grows from 130 cm as the water falls.
notes: All certified numbers check: lam/2 = 0.334961 m; /0.015 = 22.331 s; /0.019 = 17.630 s; /0.024 = 13.957 s; /0.0287 = 11.671 s. Strata agree with mine except radius: I gave C in pass 1 (through the fixed end correction); the authors' K with regime q < 0.29 lam (about 19 cm, the plane-wave cutoff) is also defensible and all listed radii lie inside it, so I accept K. Minimal pairs T49F8/T9749 and TF4FF/TEA1B share 0.9 cm/s and differ only in attachment; T3D7A and TB8E5 are numeral-free twins. The only defect is the wrong-direction column-length relation in the C cancellation claim; under rule 3 a false physics claim in the shown relations is high severity even though the answer survives. Fix: column length q + vw t, resonances at successive odd multiples (2n+1) lam/4 and (2n+3) lam/4 above q.
